name: Steps / Deployment Pipeline
description: Deployment Pipeline product scenario for the Steps component.

items.label: Verify
items.content: Health checks will confirm the release.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Ordered steps; an omitted or empty list renders no navigation. Groups and separators are dropped with a report.

controls.name: step
controls.description: Controlled index of the current step, from 0; an index past the last step shows the last one.

controls.name: defaultStep
controls.description: Uncontrolled step index on mount, from 0; read once.

controls.name: linear
controls.description: Allows only the current, an earlier or the immediately next step; does not validate forms.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables step navigation; the visible panel stays usable.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around each step button.
